title: cyclopogon goyazensis
intro: Cyclopogon goyazensis, commonly known as Goyazinha, is a plant species belonging to the family Bromeliaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Goyazinha include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Cyclopogon goyazensis include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
